archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast Tech) blended with Glassmorphism 2.0
visual_mood: Professional, efficient, AI-native, high-contrast, deep-space tech

typography.mono_font: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous: Use p-6, p-8 for cards; gap-6, gap-8 for grids to let the dark theme breathe.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Control Room Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or 12-col grid for complex layouts.
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: w-64 or w-72 fixed sidebar on desktop, hidden behind hamburger on mobile.
layout_and_spacing.page_container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8

buttons.primary: bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium hover:bg-indigo-500 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(79,70,229,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(79,70,229,0.5)] transition-all duration-200
buttons.secondary: bg-[#161b22] text-white border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium hover:bg-white/5 transition-all duration-200
buttons.ghost: text-gray-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-all duration-200

cards.glassmorphic: bg-[#0d1117]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-xl shadow-lg overflow-hidden

inputs.default: bg-[#0d1117] border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 text-white placeholder-gray-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500/50 focus:border-indigo-500 transition-all
inputs.file_upload_dropzone: border-2 border-dashed border-white/20 rounded-xl p-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 hover:border-indigo-500/50 transition-all cursor-pointer

navigation.sidebar: bg-[#0d1117]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-r border-white/10 h-screen sticky top-0

badges.default: px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/20

motion_and_interactions.page_transition: Fade in with slight upward motion (framer-motion: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}, animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }})
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons and cards should have subtle scaling (scale-105) and glow enhancements
motion_and_interactions.loading_state: Use skeleton loaders with a sweeping gradient animation (shimmer) matching the dark theme: bg-[#161b22] to bg-[#21262d]

specific_views.login_page: Split screen or centered glass card. Use the abstract dark blue technology background behind a glassmorphic login panel. The panel should be max-w-md w-full p-8 bg-[#0d1117]/70 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl.
specific_views.dashboard_grid: Bento-box style grid for projects. Each project card shows a glowing status indicator, project name, last edited date, and a subtle icon representing its current phase (transcribing, generating, complete).
specific_views.project_detail_tabs: A master layout with a top header detailing project metadata, and a robust tab navigation below. The content area renders the specific editor/viewer based on the active tab.
specific_views.transcript_editor: A clean, typography-focused view. The text area should resemble a high-end code editor or prose editor, with subtle highlights for speaker changes.
specific_views.requirements_view: Masonry or multi-column grid of cards. Functional, Non-functional, Constraints broken out into highly readable glassmorphic cards with inline edit capabilities.
specific_views.db_schema_api_viewer: Technical interface. Use Monospace fonts for data types and endpoints. Render DB tables as distinct cards with lines or clear spacing. API specs should follow a swagger-like clean layout (Method badge + Endpoint path).

images.description: Abstract blue light patterns on dark backdrop, used for login/signup page background.
Portrait of a developer, used as a placeholder for the logged-in user avatar.
Minimalist white abstract shapes, can be used or cropped as a subtle logo placeholder.

icons.instruction: Use Lucide React for all standard icons. Ensure stroke-width is consistent (typically 1.5 or 2).

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text against the #0d1117 background meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility_and_testing.focus_rings: All interactive elements must have focus-visible ring (e.g., focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500).
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, project cards) MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do not use pure black (#000000) or generic Tailwind slate/gray as backgrounds; use #0d1117 and #161b22.
Ensure the Outfit font is loaded globally (e.g., via Google Fonts) and applied to the font-sans utility in Tailwind.
Build the dashboard layout with a sticky sidebar and a scrollable main content area.
Implement glassmorphism strictly using the provided utility combinations (e.g., bg-[#0d1117]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/10).
For the audio upload feature, build a drag-and-drop zone using the file_upload_dropzone styles.
Add data-testid attributes to EVERY interactive element.
In the project detail page, use Shadcn Tabs for navigating between Transcript, Requirements, SRS, Wireframe, Schema, and API Spec.
Mock AI loading states using the sweeping gradient shimmer effect.
